meaning: Attributes on the player, PlayerGui or character, with every writer and reader in all 221 scripts. `receiver_certain` is true when the receiver resolves to Players.LocalPlayer (or below); false when the tool only matched the variable name (player, owner, character ...). reader_scripts joins reads and changed-signal listeners.
